sections.markdown:
## B — Audience, level and prerequisites: emergency and prohibited parking, freeway driving, gore areas and HOV lanes
Audience: first-time Arizona drivers and permit holders preparing for the written test in English, many of whom will soon drive on Phoenix-area and Tucson-area freeways.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the manual gives exact distances where parking is illegal and the rules for merging onto a freeway [A01], and it sets the HOV occupancy restriction and the other freeway prohibitions [A03].
Level: practical recall of three look-alike parking distances, merge and exit steps, and a list of freeway prohibitions.
Prerequisites: the space-cushion, signaling and parking pages that precede this section.

corpus_stability.reason: The Arizona Driver License Manual carries one revision line on its contents page (Revised September 2026) and points to Arizona Revised Statutes Title 28 for current law; nothing in the selected pages signals more than one rewrite per year.
